_metadata.name: Standardized Discharge Summary Template
_metadata.description: Generalizable discharge summary schema. All sections are optional — use null for fields absent from the source note. Specialty-specific information goes in additional_information.clinical_details as labeled key-value pairs.
_metadata.null_convention: Use JSON null (not the string 'Not provided') for any field absent from the source note.

patient_demographics.description: Basic patient identification and admission details.

attending_physician.description: Attending physician full name and credentials

resident_fellow.description: Resident or fellow involved in care, if documented

admission_information.description: Chief complaint and clinical context leading to admission.

chief_complaint.description: Primary reason for admission in patient or clinician terms

admitting_diagnosis.example: Stage II malignant mixed trophoblastic tumor

history_of_present_illness.description: Clinical narrative leading to admission. Preserve all dates, lab values, and provider names from source.
history_of_present_illness.example: 45-year-old female with gestational trophoblastic neoplasia presenting for cycle 1 EMA/CO...

surgical_history.description: Prior surgeries with dates if available

social_history.description: Smoking, alcohol, drugs, living situation, occupation if documented

hospital_course.description: What happened during hospitalization. Preserve all clinical detail — do not summarize.

summary.description: 1-3 sentence high-level summary of the admission
summary.example: Patient admitted for cycle 1 EMA/CO chemotherapy. Tolerated well. Discharged home in stable condition.

key_events.description: Chronological list of significant clinical events, decisions, or findings during the stay

complications.description: Complications that arose during hospitalization. Use empty array if none.

response_to_treatment.description: How the patient responded to the primary treatment or intervention
response_to_treatment.example: Tolerated chemotherapy well with nausea controlled on oral medications.

procedures_and_interventions.description: All procedures performed during this admission.

procedures.description: List of procedures. Each entry is an object with date, description, and findings.

diagnostic_results.description: Significant test results from this admission. Include dates and values exactly as documented.

laboratory.description: Key lab values as labeled key-value pairs with dates

other.description: EKG, echo, PFTs, microbiology, or any other studies

consultations.description: Specialist services involved during this admission.

consultants.description: List of consulting services. Each entry has service, reason, and key_recommendations.

discharge_diagnosis.description: Final diagnoses at time of discharge.

primary_diagnosis.example: Stage II malignant mixed trophoblastic tumor with choriocarcinoma and epithelioid trophoblastic tumor

discharge_condition.description: Patient status at time of discharge.

functional_status.description: Mobility and activities of daily living
functional_status.example: Ambulating independently, tolerating regular diet, voiding spontaneously

pain_level.description: Pain status at discharge if documented
pain_level.example: Pain well controlled on oral medications

mental_status.description: Cognitive or mental status if documented

discharge_medications.description: Complete medication regimen at discharge with reconciliation summary.

medications.description: Full medication list. Each entry has name, dose, route, frequency, indication, quantity, refills.

started.description: Medications newly started during this admission

changed.description: Medications with dose or frequency changes

continued.description: Medications continued unchanged from home regimen

pending_results.description: Tests or studies ordered but not resulted at time of discharge. Important for follow-up safety.

pending.description: Each entry has test, ordered_date, expected_location (where results will go), and action_needed.

discharge_instructions.description: Patient care instructions provided at discharge.

activity.example: Ambulate as tolerated. Avoid driving during first two treatment visits.

diet.example: Regular diet. Drink 2-3L fluids daily. Avoid raw fish, eggs, meat.

wound_care.description: Wound or incision care instructions if applicable

monitoring.description: What to watch for at home

equipment.description: Durable medical equipment provided or ordered

other.example: Take Leucovorin doses as scheduled: 11PM on 3/29 and 11AM on 3/30

recommendations.description: General follow-up recommendations not tied to a specific appointment
recommendations.example: Continue scheduled chemotherapy cycles. Follow up with ID outpatient.

patient_education.description: Education provided and warning signs reviewed with patient/family.

understanding.description: Documentation of patient/family understanding if noted
understanding.example: Patient verbalized understanding of discharge instructions.

discharge_disposition.description: Where the patient went and what support was arranged.

support_services.description: Home health, VNA, PT/OT, case management arranged

additional_information.description: Catch-all for anything not captured above.

advance_directives.description: Healthcare proxy, living will, POLST if documented

barriers_to_care.description: Social determinants of health or barriers identified

clinical_details.description: Flexible key-value pairs for any specialty-specific or uncategorized clinical information not captured in other sections. Add whatever labeled keys are relevant to this note — do not omit information just because it lacks a dedicated field.
